## Introduction

**Problem Statement:** Can a model trained on other disasters (earthquakes, wildfires, tornadoes) assess
building damage in Houston after a flood, using few or no local labels?

## Abstract

Insert abstract here.

## Background

- **Need:** Rapid building damage assessment supports disaster response and recovery.
- **Challenge:** Models trained on other disasters may struggle with Houston flooding because damage patterns and local conditions differ.
- **Dataset:** xBD provides before-and-after satellite imagery with building outlines and damage labels.
- **Research focus:** Test transfer to Houston floods with no local training labels, then measure the benefit of limited local labeling.
